jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Contracts
jobs.description:
Overview:

**About JAGGAER**

JAGGAER is a global provider of AI-powered procurement software for complex sourcing, supply and spend. More than 1,400 global enterprises across manufacturing, public sector, higher education and other industries use our platform to manage sourcing, contracts, invoicing, payments and supplier relationships in one place.

JAGGAER One connects Source-to-Contract, Procure-to-Pay and Supplier Intelligence, with embedded AI (JAI) that helps teams move faster, stay compliant and make better decisions. Our platform supports a supplier community of more than 13 million and manages $2.9 trillion in annual spend.

Behind the technology is a global team guided by our TEAM values: Transparency, Entrepreneurial Spirit, Accountability and Metrics-Driven Results.

For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com.

**Principal Product Manager - Contracts**

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

The Principal Product Manager - Contracts will be the senior individual-contributor product leader for JAGGAER's contract-management capabilities. The role will own product discovery, strategy, roadmap, and cross-functional execution for experiences that connect procurement, legal, finance, business stakeholders, and suppliers across the contract lifecycle. This position exists to improve customer outcomes, accelerate innovation, and strengthen the role of contract data and AI-enabled insights across the Source-to-Pay platform.

Principal Responsibilities:

**Principal Responsibilities**
==============================

* Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for JAGGAER's contract-management capabilities.
* Develop deep understanding of customer workflows across contract request, authoring, review, approval, negotiation, execution, repository, obligations, amendments, renewals, and analytics.
* Lead customer discovery, market research, competitive analysis, and validation to identify high-value problems and emerging opportunities.
* Translate validated needs into product outcomes, user journeys, requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable success indicators.
* Prioritize roadmap and backlog decisions using customer impact, strategic alignment, technical feasibility, risk, adoption potential, and commercial value.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, UX, QA, Security, AI & Data, and domain experts to guide solution design and predictable delivery.
* Drive integration and workflow alignment with Sourcing, Supplier Management, Supplier Intelligence, Procure-to-Pay, analytics, enterprise systems, and relevant technology partners.
* Identify responsible opportunities for AI-assisted contract work, document intelligence, risk insight, obligation visibility, and decision support.
* Facilitate scope decisions and alignment across senior stakeholders, clearly communicating trade-offs, dependencies, and roadmap rationale.
* Lead go-to-market readiness for new and enhanced capabilities through positioning input, enablement, demonstrations, release content, and customer-facing expertise.
* Measure product performance through adoption, usage, task completion, customer satisfaction, retention, and business-impact indicators.
* Act as a product-management role model by mentoring colleagues, improving product practices, and influencing cross-portfolio standards without requiring formal people-management authority.

**Success in this Position**
============================

* A clear, customer-validated Contracts strategy and roadmap is understood and supported across Product, Engineering, and go-to-market teams.
* Priority capabilities improve usability, adoption, customer satisfaction, and the value customers obtain from contract data and workflows.
* Engineering teams receive clear product context, requirements, priorities, and timely decisions that support predictable delivery.
* The Contracts experience is well integrated with the broader Source-to-Pay platform and differentiated in customer and prospect conversations.

Position Requirements:

**Must Have**

* Typically 7+ years of product-management experience in enterprise B2B SaaS, including end-to-end ownership of complex product capabilities.
* Strong domain experience in contract lifecycle management, procurement technology, legal technology, commercial contracting, or Source-to-Pay software.
* Practical understanding of enterprise contract workflows, user groups, governance needs, integrations, and adoption challenges.
* Demonstrated success leading discovery, setting strategy, prioritizing roadmaps, and launching enterprise software products.
* Strong knowledge of software development lifecycles, agile product delivery, UX collaboration, and effective partnership with Engineering.
* Analytical and metrics-driven approach to product decisions, including customer evidence, usage insights, and business outcomes.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills, with the ability to influence across functions and levels without formal authority.
* Ability to work effectively with global teams across time zones and travel periodically for customer and internal meetings.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in legal operations, commercial contracting, procurement transformation, or enterprise content/document products.
* Experience with AI, natural-language processing, document intelligence, e-signature ecosystems, or contract-data integrations.
* Experience working across European and Indian product or engineering teams.

  **What We Offer:**

  At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family’s well-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life.

jobs.description:
**Why Work Here**

* Recently expanded to nearshore
* isolved ranked for SMB Payroll in 2023 Sapient Report

**Job Description**

**Associate Product Manager, Partner Integrations**

**Summary/objective**

isolved connects its HR, payroll, and benefits platform to a growing network of strategic partners. Our partners make products for areas such as benefits brokerage, earned wage access, retirement, and compliance. In this role you will work every day from our Hyderabad office with the engineering teams that build and support these partner integrations. You will make sure each integration is clearly specified, well tested, launched smoothly, and monitored once it is live.

You will be the product voice for these teams during the India workday. You will turn partner requirements into work that is ready to build, answer questions quickly, and look for ways to make each new integration faster and more consistent than the last. You will work closely with US-based product leadership, and the role requires regular overlap with US business hours for handoffs,

**Core Job Duties**

* Write integration specifications covering data mapping, sync direction and frequency, error handling, and API dependencies
* Own backlog refinement and sprint readiness for several integration development teams
* Write user stories and acceptance criteria that engineering and QA can build and test against
* Define and run the launch checklist for each partner: certification testing, user acceptance testing, go-live readiness, and monitoring and alerts
* Spot patterns across partner integrations and push for reusable components instead of one-off builds
* Keep roadmap items current in our planning tools (Airfocus, Azure DevOps), including status, health, and risks
* Maintain known-issues and support documentation for live integrations
* Work with US-based product managers, partner teams, architecture, and support across time zones, through overlapping meetings and a daily written handoff

**Job Complexity**

A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of area of specialization. Emerging understanding of broader organizational context and goals. Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is the fully qualified, career-oriented, journey-level position

**Interaction**

Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in own area of expertise

**Supervision**

Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments.

**Experience**

Typically requires a minimum of 6–8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or equivalent work experience.

**Scope**

N/A

**Discretion**

N/A

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 6+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in business analysis or a related technical role with direct involvement in defining requirements and working with engineering teams
* Experience working with REST APIs and webhooks, and comfort reading API documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger)
* Experience with data mapping between systems
* Strong user story and acceptance criteria writing in an Agile/Scrum environment
* Clear written English. Much of the collaboration with US teams happens in writing.
* Availability for regular overlap with US business hours
* A sense of ownership: you follow problems through to resolution without waiting to be asked

**Preferred Qualfication**

* Experience with an integration platform (iPaaS) such as Workato, MuleSoft, Boomi, or similar
* Hands-on API testing with Postman or similar tools
* Domain knowledge in HR, payroll, or benefits software
* Experience working with distributed teams across time zones
* Experience using AI tools such as Claude to speed up requirements, analysis, or documentation work

**Physical Demands**

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds.

**Travel Required**

No

**FLSA Classification**

**Location**

Nearshore/Hyderabad

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

  

**Job Description**

**About Us**

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

  
  

**Global Business Services**

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.

  
  

**Process Overview**
  
ARQ supports global businesses of the Bank with solutions requiring judgment application, sound business understanding and analytical perspective. The domain experience in the areas of Financial Research & Analysis, Quantitative Modeling, Risk Management and Prospecting Support provide solutions for revenue enhancement, risk mitigation and cost optimization. The division comprising of highly qualified associates operates from three locations i.e. Mumbai, GIFT City, Gurugram, Chennai and Hyderabad.

**Job Description**

As the Platform Product Manager, you will own the platform strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and delivery for GRM wide risk data aggregation and reporting solutions. You will work cross-functionally with risk, compliance, data governance, technology, and business leadership to ensure the platform meets both regulatory requirements and internal risk management needs. You will champion data quality, lineage, aggregation, controls, and automation while embedding sustainability, scalability, and auditability into platform capabilities.

**Responsibilities:**

* Define and maintain the platform vision, roadmap, and success criteria aligned to BCBS 239 principles.
* Translate regulatory expectations into actionable platform features and capabilities.
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Technology, Data Governance, and Reporting teams to prioritize and deliver high-impact initiatives.
* Define and drive metadata management, lineage transparency, data quality monitoring, and report automation capabilities.
* Ensure the platform supports accuracy, completeness, adaptability, timeliness, and integrity of risk data.
* Collaborate with internal audit, compliance testing, and regulators on periodic reviews and assessments.
* Lead cross-functional agile squads prioritizing product backlogs, refining requirements, and overseeing product delivery.
* Develop KPI’s, platform health metrics, and risk data quality dashboards to monitor platform performance and compliance.
* Serve as the SME for BCBS 239 regulatory expectations related to data aggregation and risk reporting.

**Desired Skills:**

* 10 + years of experience in risk data management, regulatory risk reporting, or data platform product management within a bank or financial services environment.

* Deep understanding of BCBS 239 principles and their practical implementation in a large organization.

* Strong experience working with risk reporting systems, data warehouses, reporting tools, and governance frameworks.

* Familiarity with data quality frameworks, metadata management, data lineage tools, and control monitoring.

* Proven track record of defining and delivering product roadmaps for complex data management or reporting platforms.

* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership skills.

* Proficiency in Agile delivery methodologies (e.g. Scrum, SAFe).

* Excellent communication skills (written, verbal and presentation) with the ability to translate regulatory language into actionable technical requirements.

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

  

**Requirements :**

  
  

* Education : graduate
* Experience :Minimum 8+ years
  

  

**Job Location -Chennai /Hyderabad**

Come be a part of a world of potential at Computershare Business Support Services.

We offer continuous learning and education opportunities and put emphasis on continued improvement and growth.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you passionate about building software that makes a meaningful difference for millions of customers? As a Software Development Engineer II at Amazon, you will own and deliver features across the full software development lifecycle—from understanding customer needs through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. You will tackle complex technical problems, bring clarity to ambiguous challenges, and craft solutions that are simple, maintainable, and built to scale. This is a role where your engineering contributions have direct, visible impact on the products and experiences our customers rely on every day. If you are a curious, self-motivated engineer who thrives on collaboration and continuous learning, we would love to hear from you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement software solutions that address customer needs, working across the full development lifecycle including scoping, coding, testing, deployment, and ongoing operations.
* Write high-quality, well-documented, and maintainable code while actively participating in code reviews to provide meaningful feedback and mentor fellow engineers on your team.
* Collaborate with cross-functional partners including product managers, stakeholders, and peer engineers to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues, driving permanent fixes and continuously improving your team's operational processes and software reliability.
* Evaluate emerging tools and approaches—including generative AI capabilities—to recommend and adopt improvements that enhance productivity and solution quality.

  
A day in the life  
Your morning might start with a design discussion where you sketch out the architecture for a new feature, weighing tradeoffs around scalability and maintainability with your teammates. After lunch, you could be deep in code, building and testing a component that will ship incrementally to customers. Between focused coding sessions, you review pull requests from peers, share constructive feedback, and help onboard a new team member by walking them through how your services operate and fit into the broader system.  
  
About the team  
Our team is committed to building reliable, customer-focused software that operates at Amazon scale. We value collaboration, technical rigor, and an inclusive environment where every engineer's perspective is heard. Whether you are refactoring existing systems or launching new capabilities, you will be part of a group that invests in long-term quality and encourages continuous growth. We are excited about the road ahead and looking for engineers who want to help shape what comes next.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence
* Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

------------

### **Build our future together:**

Regeneron is founded on the belief that the right idea, combined with the right team, can lead to significant transformations. Our growing global network is dedicated to inventing, developing, and commercializing medicines that change lives for those with serious diseases. In doing so, we are pioneering innovative ways to science, manufacturing, and commercialization, as well as redefining our understanding of health.

  
  

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking a Patient Access Analytics Analyst to join our growing Global Capability Center (GCC) in Hyderabad. In this role, you will support standardized patient access reporting and analytics across Regeneron's portfolio, including copay and Patient Assistance Program (PAP) tracking, patient support program reporting, reimbursement analytics, and patient journey analysis. Working closely with US-based Market Access and Field Reimbursement teams, you will help deliver actionable insights, support operational excellence, and contribute to the development of scalable patient access analytics capabilities within the GCC.

Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)

* Contribute to KPI development and reporting aligned with Field Reimbursement and Market Access business objectives.
  

  

### **This role requires:**

* 2-3 years of experience in analytics, market access, patient support programs, healthcare analytics, or related data-focused roles.
* Experience working with patient support program (PSP) data, including Copay-PAP utilization and tracking metrics.
* Strong analytical skills with experience in data validation, data wrangling, trend analysis, and business reporting.
* Ability to interpret patient access data and translate findings into meaningful business insights.

**Job Title**

Sr. Devops Engineer, Senior Associate

  
  

**Role Summary & Role Description**

We are seeking a talented Senior Software Engineer to join our agile team. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products, with a focus on Devop practice

  
  

Candidate must have 4+ years of relevant experience in Design, build, and manage cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure

Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and Harness

Containerize applications using Docker and manage deployments using Kubernetes and Helm

Develop and manage infrastructure using Terraform / Terraform Enterprise (TFE)

Automate build, deployment, and release processes for multiple environments

Ensure platform reliability, scalability, performance, and security

Integrate security and compliance tools such as BlackDuck and Veracode into CI/CD pipelines

Collaborate with development, QA, and security teams to support application delivery

Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, deployment, and runtime issues

Create and maintain technical documentation and operational runbooks

Good knowledge in Devops concepts and different CI/CD tools like Azure Devops and Harness

CI/CD tools: Azure DevOps, Harness

Good knowledge on Azure Databricks,Snowflake,Python scription.

On-premise / Hybrid

Devops, Azure and Terraform

  
  

**Why this role is important to us**

Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence and robotics process automation.

  
  

We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end-to-end, next-generation financial services company.

  
  

Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems and make your mark on our industry.

  
  
  

**About State Street**

  

**What we do.** State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.

  
  

**Work, Live and Grow.** We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary by location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans, among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Programs to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.

  
  

**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.** We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift programs and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.

State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.

  
  

Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers

  
  

**About State Street**

**What You Will Do**
The Digital Product Manager (DPM) is the technology product leader for one or more Manufacturing data and analytics products. In partnership with the Business Product Owner (BPO), the DPM shapes product direction, co-owns the roadmap and backlog ordering, and is jointly accountable for delivery and product results across Build and RunOps. The DPM represents Technology in product discussions and business negotiations, leads technology-side communications, and serves as the decision maker for product-level technical decisions. * Co-own product direction, roadmap, backlog ordering, and outcome delivery with the BPO; ensure priorities connect user and manufacturing needs to measurable product and business outcomes.

**Position Overview**
We are looking for a
**Staff Product Manager, Compute Platform**
who is passionate about running managed compute services at scale, namely App Platform, Serverless Functions, and Container Registry, and who understands that a great platform experience is built on well-run infrastructure underneath it.
  
  
As a Staff Product Manager, Compute Platform at DigitalOcean, you will join a dynamic team dedicated to revolutionizing cloud computing. You will own the product strategy and roadmap for App Platform, Serverless Functions, and Container Registry (DOCR), the managed compute services that turn DO's Droplet fleet into a place where developers can ship without thinking about servers. That means owning both sides of each service, the developer-facing product and the platform economics beneath it, such as how workloads are packed onto compute, what each app, function, or image pull costs to serve, and how processor, virtualization, and container runtime trends shape our roadmap. You will report to the Director of Product and partner day to day with the Hyderabad-based Compute Cloud Services engineering team that builds the business logic, APIs, and control plane for DO Compute, as well as with our Droplet/VPC, Kubernetes, and infrastructure product peers, finance, and GTM. The ideal person becomes the PM who can hold a customer conversation about deploy workflows in the morning and a capacity and margin conversation in the afternoon, the partner engineering trusts on architecture tradeoffs, and a core part of building out the compute platform PM group in India.

* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for App Platform, Serverless Functions, and DOCR, aligned with DO's overall compute platform strategy, and translate them into prioritized, well-scoped features that are simple to use and efficient to run.
* Own the platform economics of these services. Define how apps, functions, and registry storage map onto Droplets and shared compute, track cost to serve per unit of customer workload, and drive utilization, density, and bin-packing improvements with engineering and finance.
* Stay ahead of the compute landscape that underpins the platform, including processor roadmaps from Intel, AMD, and ARM, virtualization and microVM technologies, and container runtimes and isolation models, and translate those trends into platform decisions such as instance sizing, runtime choices, and price/performance tiers.
* Define the end-to-end developer journey across these services, from source repo or container image to a deployed, autoscaled, observable app or function, and remove the seams (auth, networking, registry, logs, billing) that make customers stitch it together themselves today.
* Work backwards from customers. Run discovery with developers, startups, and SMB platform teams, mine support and community signal, and turn it into clear jobs-to-be-done, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Own packaging and pricing for platform services, including how compute, egress, build minutes, storage, invocations, and image pulls are metered, how pricing tracks cost to serve, and how the services attach to Droplets, GPUs, managed databases, DOKS, and Spaces.
* Partner with engineering on architecture tradeoffs in the control plane and data plane, such as build pipelines, autoscaling and scheduling behavior, cold start and concurrency for Serverless Functions, registry performance and garbage collection, and multi-region placement.
* Drive performance, reliability, and efficiency outcomes with clear SLOs and cost targets, and champion the fixes that move them.
* Monitor the competitive landscape for managed compute and PaaS offerings, and identify where DO can differentiate on simplicity, price/performance, or both.
* Lead launches end to end with product marketing, docs, sales, and support, and own the results after GA, including adoption, activation, retention, and margin.

Key metrics
  
  

* Platform services revenue and attach rate (share of Droplet, GPU, database, and DOKS customers also running App Platform or Serverless Functions, and share pulling from DOCR).
* Infrastructure efficiency, measured as fleet utilization and density for the compute serving these services, and cost per unit of customer workload (per app instance, per invocation, per GB stored and pulled).
* Gross margin per service, and the gap between pricing and cost to serve as the fleet and processor mix evolve.
* Activation, retention, and expansion, measured as time to first deploy and as apps, functions, and registries active at 30/90/180 days.
* Reliability and performance against SLO, e.g. deploy and build success rate, control plane availability, Serverless Functions cold start p95, image pull latency.

* Define canonical consumer entities, such as customer, account, transaction, fee, merchant, country and currency, so they mean the same thing across products.
* Decide where products share a common model and where they need their own structures, and document the reasoning.
* Define single, governed definitions for core consumer KPIs such as active customers, revenue per user, lifetime value and churn.
* Write requirements engineers can build from: source-to-target mappings, grain, keys, history rules and data-quality checks.
* Track adoption: which teams have moved to the new models, how much they’re being used, and how many metric discrepancies have been resolved.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or an MBA, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years in a data product or risk data role.
* Experience starting with many competing data requests, choosing the few to build first, defining an MVP, and explaining the trade-offs to stakeholders.
* Experience working with engineering to deliver a data lake/lakehouse, data warehouse or shared data model used by multiple teams.
* Experience bringing together inconsistent data from multiple source systems into common entities, keys and definitions.
* Hands-on SQL: you can join across tables, profile data for nulls and duplicates, reconcile counts between systems, and check whether data supports a use case without waiting for an analyst.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with consumer payments, digital wallets or fintech.
* Experience with payments risk data such as fraud, account takeover, KYC/AML or transaction monitoring signals.
* Experience with modern cloud data platforms and tools, such as Snowflake, Databricks, dbt or major cloud providers’ data services.

jobs.description:
Limagrain is a global company with deep local roots. Our parent company is an agricultural cooperative based in the Limagne-Val d’Allier plain, in the heart of Central France’s Auvergne region, while we are an international seed and agri-food group with some 9,600 employees working in 53 countries.
  
  
As the 4th largest seed company in the world, we achieved sales of 2.522 billion euros in 2023-2024, with additional sales of 729 million euros from activities carried out in collaboration with our strategic partners.
  
  
HM.CLAUSE is a business unit of Limagrain (https://www.limagrain.com/), an international co-operative agricultural group, specializing in field seeds, vegetable seeds and cereal products.
  
  
With a team of 2,800 professionals in over 30 countries, we are dedicated to the sustainable solutions for the land, successful products for our customers, and intensive research and innovations for the future. HM Clause is a leading vegetable seeds company with successful product development for more than 200 years. Headquartered in France we have operations across countries like Mexico, USA, France, Spain, Italy, India, Vietnam and Thailand. We have a diverse set of customers, across regions, who engage with us at various touchpoints, to gain more information about our products and benefits. Considering our products are launched after years of R&D and the impact on the customer’s life is significant, our communication has been largely product benefits-led. In India, we have been operating for last 10 years and are known for our commercial brand – Clause seeds.
  
  
**Marketing Product Manager**
**Main Goal**
The Product Manager is responsible for the product planning and execution throughout the product lifecycle, including gathering and prioritizing product and customer requirements, work with PD and Sales on developing go-to-market strategy, life cycle management and working closely with R&D, sales, Operations and support functions to ensure revenue and customer satisfaction goals are met. The Product Manager’s job also includes ensuring that product strategy is aligned and contributes to the company’s Strategic Road Map.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Portfolio Life Cycle Management and Performance:**

* Portfolio/Life Cycle Management: In close collaboration with key stakeholders, manage new product introductions and phase-out plans to maintain a highly competitive and profitable portfolio.
* Lead Product Advancement Platforms in strategic markets to maximize pipeline potential and portfolio opportunities.
* Optimize turnover and margin of managed products through supply planning alignment, sales potential evaluation, and product pricing guidance.
* Lead the global pipeline and portfolio assessment process for target markets, identifying gaps, risks, and opportunities.
* Provide sales and communication teams with technical product information and value proposition support to maximize product performance and commercial success. Actively participate in the implementation of marketing activities for new products (NPI), including segmentation, targeting, positioning and value pricing.
* Manage seed quantity requirements for varieties under development through close collaboration with Sales and Product Development Managers in preparation for commercial launch.
* Collaborate with S&OP teams to effectively manage seed availability for the commercial portfolio, supporting production and inventory management decisions.
* Maintain and improve product quality consistency through collaboration with Production, Operations, Inventory Management, and Seed Technology teams.
* Manage the development and introduction of new seed product forms in collaboration with Seed Technology, Research, and Sales.
* Contribute to the validation of sales projections and Product Development resource allocation, ensuring alignment with portfolio priorities, market opportunities, and business objectives.
* Gather and analyze market and competitive intelligence to support portfolio management, product requirements, and pipeline decision-making.

**Strategy:**

* Develop crop strategy and coordinate actions and projects required for its implementation with key internal stakeholders.
* Define breeding objectives and product specifications for the medium and long term based on a strong understanding of market dynamics, customer needs, and the competitive environment.
* Develop and implement product trial plans in collaboration with breeders and regional Product Development teams based on market knowledge and strategic objectives. Assess trial results to determine product performance and life cycle direction.

**Strategic Planning, Forecasting and Analysis**
– Ability to initiate and lead the planning and analysis of market data, through constant communication and coordination with research, development, and sales teams, in order to evaluate main targets. Ability to plan actions, execute, follow-up and analyze results.
  
  
**Technical Skills**
– Practical knowledge and experience in breeding, seed development, seed sales or seed or vegetable production is favored. Project management ability needed. Prior experience in dealing with vegetables seeds preferred.
  
  
**Interpersonal Skills**
– Possess strong leadership and communication skills. Ability to develop and maintain productive work relationships with various positions within the organization such as breeders, lab personnel, sales and product development teams, seed production department, inventory management, quality control, operations plant managers, communications, product management, and technical data teams. Play a coordination role with key stakeholders.

**ABOUT ELEVANCE HEALTH**

Elevance Health is a leading health company in America dedicated to improving lives and communities and making healthcare simpler. It is the largest managed health care company in the Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS) Association serving more than 112 million lives across 14 states.

A regular in **Fortune** 500 list, **Elevance Health** ranked **20** in 2022. Gail Boudreaux, President and CEO of Elevance Health has been a consistent name in the Fortune list of most powerful women and currently holds 4th rank on this list.

**ABOUT CARELON**

Carelon Global Solutions (CGS) is a healthcare solutions company that is simplifying complex operational processes to improve the health of the healthcare system.

Previously known as Legato Health Technologies, Carelon Global Solutions (hereinafter, CGS) underwent a name change and joined the Carelon family of brands in January 2023, as a fully owned subsidiary of Elevance Health *(Previously Anthem Inc.).* CGS brings together a global team of like-minded innovators who manage and optimize operational processes for health plans as well as providers.

Our brightest minds housed across our global headquarters in Indianapolis as well as Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Gurugram in India, Manila in the Philippines, Limerick in Ireland and San Juan in Puerto Rico bring with them innovative capabilities and an unmatched depth of experience. This global team uniquely positions CGS to enable scalable, next-generation platforms and specialized digital tools that make healthcare operations more practical, effective and efficient.

jobs.title: Generative AI Developer - Hyd/Bang/Chennai
jobs.description:
Dear candidate,

Please find the JD for the AI Developer role below, let me know if you have any questions.

**Role Summary**  
We are looking for an AI Developer to design, build, and run agentic AI systems: software agents that plan, call tools, use company data, and complete multi-step tasks with controlled human oversight. You will work with several model providers and model sizes, choosing and routing between them for quality, speed, cost, and data-handling needs, ensuring no single model or vendor becomes a point of failure.  
This is a hands-on engineering role. You will write production code, build evaluation harnesses, and take agents from prototype to a monitored, secure, and supportable service.  
**Key Responsibilities**  
**Agent design and build**  
• Design and build agents and multi-agent workflows that plan, use tools, keep state, and complete multi-step business tasks.  
• Choose the right pattern for each problem (single agent, workflow with fixed steps, supervisor and worker agents, human-in-the-loop approval) and explain the trade-offs.  
• Write and maintain prompts, system instructions, tool definitions, and structured output schemas as versioned code.  
• Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and memory components, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector or hybrid search, and citation of sources.  
**Multi-model strategy and orchestration**  
• Work with several model families and providers (for example Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini, and open-weight models such as Llama or Mistral) through hosted APIs, cloud platforms (AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, Google Vertex AI), and self-hosted inference.  
• Build a model abstraction and routing layer that selects models by task type, quality, latency, cost, context length, and data-residency rules, with fallbacks when a provider fails or rate-limits.  
• Benchmark models on our own tasks and data, record the results, and re-evaluate when new models or versions are released.  
• Manage cost and latency through caching, batching, prompt compression, smaller models for simple steps, and token budgets.  
**Tools and integrations**  
• Connect agents to enterprise systems through REST and SOAP APIs, databases, message queues, files, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or equivalent tool standards.  
• Design tools with clear contracts, least-privilege access, input validation, idempotency, and safe handling of errors and retries.  
• Build integrations for document processing, search, email and messaging, workflow engines, and line-of-business applications such as claims, policy, and finance systems.  
**Evaluation and quality**  
• Build evaluation suites with golden datasets, automated checks, model-graded and human review, and regression tests that run on every change to prompts, tools, or models.  
• Measure task success, accuracy, groundedness, tool-call correctness, latency, and cost, and report them to stakeholders.  
• Run red-team and adversarial tests, including prompt injection, data leakage, and tool misuse.  
**Safety, security, and governance**  
• Apply guardrails: input and output filtering, permission checks before actions, approval steps for high-impact actions, and audit logs of every agent decision and tool call.  
• Protect personal and health data (PII and PHI) through masking, access control, encryption, retention rules, and region-appropriate hosting, in line with applicable regulations (for example data-privacy law and sector rules such as IRDAI).  
• Document model choices, known limitations, and risks, and support internal AI governance and model risk reviews.  
**Operations and collaboration**  
• Deploy agents through CI/CD pipelines to cloud or container platforms, with tracing, monitoring, alerting, usage and cost dashboards, and incident runbooks.  
• Provide L2/L3 support for agent incidents and carry out root-cause analysis, including bad outputs, tool failures, and model regressions.  
• Work with business owners, product managers, security, data, and integration teams to scope use cases, define success metrics, and plan rollout.  
• Review code and designs, mentor developers new to LLM engineering, and keep technical documentation and an internal catalog of agents, tools, and approved models.  
**Required Qualifications**  
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).  
• 4+ years of software development experience, including 1+ year building LLM-based applications that reached production.  
• Strong Python (and/or TypeScript or Java) with clean, tested, maintainable code.  
• Hands-on experience building agents with tool or function calling, structured outputs, and multi-step workflows, using a framework (for example LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or a vendor agent SDK) or custom orchestration.  
• Practical experience with at least two model providers or families, and an understanding of their differences in context length, tool-use behavior, cost, latency, and data-handling terms.  
• Experience with RAG: embeddings, vector or hybrid search, chunking strategies, and retrieval quality tuning.  
• Experience designing evaluations for LLM systems (test sets, automated and human review, regression checks).  
• Strong API and integration skills (REST, JSON, OAuth2, webhooks) and SQL.  
• Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD, containers (Docker), and at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).  
• Understanding of LLM security risks (prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agent permissions) and of handling sensitive data.  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
• Experience running open-weight models (for example with vLLM, Ollama, or managed endpoints) and knowledge of quantization, serving, and GPU cost trade-offs.  
• Experience with fine-tuning or adapting models (LoRA, preference tuning, distillation) and judging when it is worth doing instea…

-----------------------

AbhiBus is a leading online bus-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators - including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3.5 lakh (350,000+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.

AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms - ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The TPM owns predictable, high-quality delivery across AbhiBus's technology programs. This is not a scrum-master role: you drive outcomes end to end, from planning through release to post-launch analysis.

You will be the connective tissue between engineering, QA, product and business stakeholders. You keep everyone aligned on scope, dates, risks and dependencies, so teams spend time building, not chasing status.

After every major release, you close the loop: measure impact, run retrospectives and post-analysis, and publish learnings across the organisation. As you grow, you will take on larger, multi-team programs.

Key responsibilities

**Delivery ownership**

* Own the delivery plan for assigned programs across 2–3 squads: scope, milestones, timelines, owners and dependencies.
* Break business and product goals into executable technical plans with engineering leads.
* Track progress daily, surface slippage early, and drive decisions to keep releases on date.
* Maintain a single, trusted source of truth for program status (roadmap, release calendar, risk register).
* Manage cross-team dependencies across backend, frontend, mobile, QA, DevOps, data and partner integrations.

**Scrum and agile execution**

* Run sprint ceremonies: planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, reviews and retrospectives.
* Keep backlogs healthy and sprint-ready with Product, with clear acceptance criteria.
* Track sprint health metrics (velocity, commitment vs completion, carry-over, cycle time) and act on trends.
* Remove blockers quickly and escalate with clear options when needed.

**Stakeholder coordination**

* Act as the single point of coordination between Tech, QA, Product, Design, Business and Operations.
* Align stakeholders on priorities, trade-offs and scope changes; document decisions.
* Publish crisp weekly status updates and present program status in leadership reviews.
* Coordinate with external partners and vendors on integration timelines where needed.

**Release and quality management**

* Run the release process for your squads: release readiness, go/no-go, deployment coordination and rollback plans.
* Work with QA to ensure test plans, regression coverage and sign-off are in place before release.
* Coordinate hotfixes and production incidents with engineering; ensure follow-ups are tracked to closure.

**Post-analysis and publishing**

* Run post-release analysis for every major feature: delivery vs plan, quality, and business impact against agreed metrics.
* Run blameless postmortems with engineering leads for incidents and missed deliveries; drive action items to closure.
* Publish post-analysis reports and learnings across Tech, Product and Business.
* Turn recurring learnings into process improvements, templates and checklists.

------------------

* 2–5 years in software delivery, with 1+ year as a TPM, scrum master, delivery manager or project manager in a product company.
* Strong technical grounding: can follow architecture discussions, APIs, microservices, mobile releases and CI/CD, and judge engineering estimates and risks.
* Track record of shipping features across multiple teams on time in a fast-moving consumer or marketplace business.
* Hands-on Scrum/Agile experience running ceremonies for at least one team.
* Working knowledge of Jira (or similar), Confluence and roadmap/reporting tools.
* Data-driven: comfortable defining success metrics and reading dashboards to analyse feature impact.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; can write clear status reports and post-analysis documents for leadership.
* Ownership mindset: drives to outcomes, not just tracks tasks.

**Good to have**

Engineering background (B.E./B.Tech or equivalent), ideally with prior hands-on development or QA experience. Experience in travel, ticketing, e-commerce or marketplace platforms with partner/supplier integrations. Familiarity with mobile app release cycles (Play Store / App Store) and staged rollouts. jobs.title: Program Manager II
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you excited about building catalog operations for a new grocery store program from the ground up? Do you thrive when the problem isn't fully defined yet and you have to frame it before you can solve it? We are looking for a Program Manager to own catalog readiness for a new grocery retail initiative in Grocery Catalog Operations & Intel (GCOI). In this role, you will make sure every item the business plans for its stores has the product data that in-store systems need, such as point of sale, shelf labels, store ordering and planogramming, before those systems need it. You will turn open questions into decisions with owners and dates, put catalog milestones into the program's master schedule, and build the readiness checks and operating mechanisms that a catalog operations team runs store by store. Your ability to work through ambiguity, influence partners you don't manage, and raise risks early will be critical to your success and the success of the program.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own catalog readiness end to end, including catalog milestones in the program's master workback schedule, a readiness check before each assortment and shelf-layout lock, and a go/no-go recommendation before each store opens.
* Frame ambiguous problems, name the decisions partner teams owe, and drive owners and dates across merchandising, category management, supply chain, store systems and catalog engineering.
* Define catalog data requirements with in-store system owners, including which attributes each system needs by product type and where each value comes from. Find where the program falls outside existing catalog processes and get those gaps fixed at the source rather than worked around by hand.
* Build the operating model with the catalog operations manager, including intake, SOPs, SLAs, escalation paths and a store-open runbook, and improve it as the program grows from one store to many.
* Define and publish catalog coverage and readiness metrics against the planned selection, using data to flag risks early, inform trade-offs and recommend where to invest.

  
A day in the life  
You might start your morning reviewing the weekly coverage report and notice that a category locks its shelf layouts in three weeks with a third of its items missing dimensions. You trace the cause to a data pipeline that only covers fully configured stores. By mid-morning, you are in the program schedule review with an owner and a date for the fix, and a fallback agreed with merchandising. After lunch, you work with the operations manager on the next store-open runbook, then draft a one-page note to leadership on an ownership question that needs a decision.  
  
About the team  
Grocery Catalog Operations & Intel (GCOI) runs catalog operations across Amazon's grocery businesses, including Whole Foods Market, Amazon Fresh, Grocery Partnerships and Quick Commerce. We create, match, validate and correct the product data that customers and stores depend on, and we build our own monitoring and automation so the team that finds a defect can fix it at the source. New store programs and marketplace launches across grocery rely on us for their catalog foundation. If you want to build something new and see your work on the shelf on opening day, we would love to hear from you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

The ServiceNow Business Analyst plays a key role in aligning business needs with technical implementation within the ServiceNow platform.  
  

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.

* Consults with business stakeholders to understand and evaluate current business processes and identify complex business problems and needs turning those needs into system requirements
* Analyses business requirements and translating them into actionable ServiceNow tasks and projects.
* Provides technical expertise for system functional specifications and deploys new and current systems, processes and procedures in a cost-effective manner
* Works closely with stakeholders, including business users, ServiceNow architects, and developers, to ensure solutions align with organizational goals and are implemented effectively.
* Translate high-level process definitions into detailed ServiceNow implementation designs (epics, features, user stories)
* May configure system settings and options; plan and execute unit, system, and integration testing to meet business requirements. May lead cross-functional linked teams to address business or systems issues.
* Conduct testing and ensure quality assurance
* Create and update documentation
* Foster innovation and exploration of new solutions
* Works independently under limited supervision to determine and develop approach to solutions.
* Communicates with senior internal and external customers and vendors
May provide guidance, coaching and training to other employees within job area.  

Required Knowledge and Expertise:

  

* 7+ years of IT experience with a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, MCA, or MSc. and 5+ years of ServiceNow experience with demonstrated success in managing technical teams in global organizations
* Preferred but not mandatory: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, Certified Implementation Specialist – IT Service Management (CIS - ITSM), Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management (CIS – CSM) and/or Certified Implementation Specialist – Human Resources (CIS – HR)
* Strong coordination skills are essential for managing communication, expectations, and deliverables across all teams
* Proficiency in business and IT agile methodologies; experience with Scrum/Agile frameworks
* Hands-on expertise in ServiceNow
* Familiarity with software engineering principles and design patterns
* Knowledge of software security practices
* High level of curiosity about emerging technologies
* Ability to advocate for out-of-the-box ServiceNow solutions while aligning with business needs
* Experience in working with distributed, multicultural teams
* Strong analytical skills with a solution-driven mindset
* Capability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey technical concepts clearly
* Initiative and proactive mindset
Fluency in English  

**Physical Job Requirements**  
  
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
‌
‌

**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:

  

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.

  

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.

  

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.

  

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com .

**Benefits & Compensation**
===========================

**Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package**  
A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.  
‌

jobs.description:
**About us:**

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritise relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

**Target Global Supply Chain and Logistics** is evolving at an incredible pace. We are constantly reimagining how we get the right product to the guest even better, faster and more cost effectively than before. We are becoming more intelligent, automated and algorithmic in our decision-making, so that no matter how guests shop—in stores or on Target.com—we deliver the convenience and immediate gratification they demand and deserve. We are on a mission to win decisively over any competitor, with a seamless and superior guest service experience unlike any they can offer. Our teams work with the agility our mission requires, and we constantly come together to implement new processes in record time. So we’re looking for exceptional people who are proactive, creative, independent, innovative, risk-savvy and comfortable working in varying degrees of ambiguity. Are you a critical thinker who seeks the root cause and can analyse both qualitatively and quantitatively? Are you a creative problem-solver who simplifies problems, quickly identifies solutions, commits to a plan and then positively influences others to execute it? If so, you will have success on one of our dynamic teams.

**About the Job:**

The Senior Product Manager - Inventory Purchasing and Positioning is responsible for executing the strategy and this role will lead the product design, delivery of modern inventory systems. Our team and products enable the ability for Inventory Management teams to effectively manage the synchronized flow of inventory into and throughout Target's supply chain network. This role will work closely with supply chain product/business partners, enterprise capacity planning and data science teams. This role will act as the subject matter expert (SME) for the engineering teams and lead the development of the prioritized features along with systematic scale and performance enhancements to support business growth.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will collaborate with your product team and key stakeholders to develop a plan and business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product. You will need to build a strong knowledge of your product through product discovery to collect customer feedback and work to collect other relevant data points that explain the value and help you prioritise the direction and desired outcomes for your product. You will work in unison with engineers, operations, data scientists and business partners to deliver a product.

You will be the “voice of the product” with your product team and stakeholders to ensure that their needs are met, and you will be responsible to maintain and refine the product backlog (create user stories & acceptance criteria) while prioritising the backlog to focus on the highest impact work for your team and stakeholders. You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. You will foster sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles.

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**Reporting/Working Relationships**

* Reports to Director, Product Management
* Located at Target India.
* Working Relationships: Works closely with Target Tech engineering teams and business product teams in India and United States, Global Supply Chain & Logistics, Digital, Stores, Target Finance and Accounting, enterprise capacity planning and Data Science

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor’s Degree
* 8+ years Supply chain experience
* 3+ years’ experience with Purchasing and Positioning
* 4+ years’ experience working in product and agile model
* Knowledge of Procurement – First mile, Replenishment, Order Management, Optimization/Sub optimization, TMS, WMS, Carrier Labeling and interactions
* Knowledge of B2B interactions (EDI, XML, APIs)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Strong business, technology and data acumen with interest towards AI/ML solutions.
* Strong communication skills w/ proven ability to communicate across business and technology teams as well as different levels of leadership.

**Know More About Us here:**

* **Life at Target**: https://india.target.com/
* **Benefits**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/workplace/benefits
* **Culture**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/belonging
* **Target** **Tech**: https://tech.target.com/

jobs.title: Product Manager II - DAU Labs
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------

Meesho is the most downloaded e-commerce app in India. As part of the core Business and Product Experience team, we are taking a massive leap from a purely transactional e-commerce platform to a destination for visual discovery and personal inspiration.

We are building an immersive feed inside the Meesho app, focused on look-based, trend-based, and highly personalized inspiration across major lifestyle categories like Fashion, Home, and Beauty.

The DAU Labs team focuses on building engaging discovery experiences, scaling content supply, and solving complex personalization and ranking problems to drive user engagement, daily active users (DAU), and long-term retention.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Product Manager II at DAU Labs, you will play a key role in building and scaling Meesho's content-led discovery experience. You will work on creating engaging and personalized product experiences that help millions of users discover relevant trends, products, and inspiration.

You will own key product problems across content discovery, personalization, user engagement, and conversion. Working closely with Engineering, Data Science, Design, and Business teams, you will identify opportunities, drive product improvements, and deliver measurable impact on DAU growth and user retention.

### **What you will do**

* **Product Strategy & Ownership:** Own key product areas within the content discovery ecosystem, identify user and business problems, and define product roadmaps aligned with DAU growth objectives.
* **Discovery & Personalization:** Work on improving content discovery, feed relevance, recommendation systems, and personalization to deliver engaging experiences tailored to different user cohorts.
* **User Engagement & Growth:** Identify opportunities to improve user engagement, daily active usage, session frequency, and long-term retention through data-driven product initiatives.
* **Experimentation & Analytics:** Drive product experiments, A/B testing, and data analysis to identify growth opportunities, measure product performance, and continuously improve user experience.

**Product Mgr II**

**Do you want to make signing in to Elsevier products simple and secure?**

**Can you build identity and access products together with the product teams who depend on them?**

**About Our Team:-**

Our team owns Identity, Access and API Management for Elsevier. We're focused on making access to our products frictionless and secure, with modern access solutions that make customer onboarding easier and sign-in simpler, without compromising security. We work closely with the product managers of Elsevier's products, and with Technology, Design, Data, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, to solve real customer access problems. We value curiosity, innovation, and continuous improvement, and are committed to delivering exceptional experiences for our customers.

  

**About the Role:-**

As a Product Manager II on our team, you will work toward owning the end-to-end value and outcomes of identity and access features, from discovery through to delivery and adoption. You will act as the voice of the customer, using market insight, customer feedback, and data to identify opportunities and define solutions that make sign-in, onboarding and access management easy for customers, while meeting Elsevier's security and compliance bar.

  

Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will drive product requirements through specs for your feature area (using genAI and Spec-Driven Development (SDD) as part of your process), execute against the roadmap, and keep your features running well day to day. This role is ideal for a product professional who enjoys combining customer insight, a user-centric approach and data-driven decision-making. You'll partner directly with one or two engineering squads, running discovery through to delivery for your slice of the product, within an overall roadmap and prioritisation set by our Senior Product Manager for Identity and Access. From there, you'll grow into progressively larger scope, working toward owning the full arc of discovery, delivery, and outcomes for your own product area.

  

**Responsibilities:-**

* Own discovery and requirements for several product areas through the product lifecycle — including cross-product functionality (collaborating with other teams within the wider Identity and Access group) and end-to-end release process including collaboration with go-to-market.

* Gather customer insights at the source (customers, institutional admins, Customer Support) and use them, with data and market analysis, to drive product requirements and decisions.
* Own go-to-market and ongoing support for your features, including release plans and stakeholder communications for your product area
* Own how success metrics are defined and calculated, including adoption after release, ensuring they reflect business outcomes.
* Effectively prioritise customer issues, defects, and feature requests for resolution against the ongoing product roadmap.
* Monitor market trends and competitor activity in the identity and access space to inform your product decisions.
  

**Requirements:-**

* Proven Product Management experience, typically with 4-6 years in a product-focused role.
* Hands-on product experience in identity and access, for example authentication, single sign-on (SAML or OpenID Connect), user or customer onboarding, entitlements, or admin tools.
* Experience owning products, features, or significant areas of product functionality. Experience with platform products used by other product teams is a plus.
* Experience working closely with other product managers on shared roadmaps or cross-product features, including resolving conflicting priorities.

* Excellent analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation abilities, including with teams in other time zones.
* Experience working within Agile software development environments. Experience using genAI in product work is a plus.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required; a technical or business-related degree is preferred.
  

  

**Work in a way that works for you: -**

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. With an average length of service of 9 years, we are confident that we offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, family leave and tuition reimbursement, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and long-term goals.Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

jobs.description:
Overview:

**Are you ready for what’s next, now?**  
  
**About the Role**

The **Staff** **Product Manager – Data & Analytics** supports the definition and evolution of Aptean's semantic data models and Analytics Packages across business domains and products. The role translates business processes, metrics, reporting requirements, and underlying product data into reusable semantic definitions that can support analytics and AI use cases. Working closely with domain SMEs, customers, Product, Data Engineering, and Architecture, this role drives requirements from discovery through definition, technical validation, and customer validation. The role requires a strong combination of product thinking, business analysis, analytics, and hands-on understanding of relational data and data modeling.

We need a candidate who sits with an ERP SME or business user, understand the business process; inspect the underlying data/schema; define the business entities/KPIs; map source concepts to the semantic model; write requirements detailed enough for Engineering; validate the implementation (reports, AI query, or Agent outputs) with SMEs/customers.

**Knowledge:**

Requires strong working knowledge of data and analytics concepts, including relational data models, business entities and relationships, semantic modeling, analytical metrics/KPIs, and data transformation from operational systems into analytics-ready structures.

Requires the ability to understand business processes and reporting requirements and translate them into detailed data and semantic-model definitions. You must be comfortable analyzing source schemas, tables, fields, relationships, and existing reporting assets in partnership with Engineering and domain experts.

Requires working knowledge of product management and business analysis practices, including requirements definition, customer and SME discovery, prioritization, documentation, validation, and cross-functional product development.

Knowledge of enterprise software, ERP systems, modern cloud data platforms, BI tools, and AI-enabled analytics is preferred.

**Complexity:**

Works across multiple business domains, ERP/product schemas, and analytics use cases where business terminology, source data structures, and customer requirements may differ.

Translates sometimes ambiguous business questions and existing reporting requirements into standardized entities, measures, dimensions, relationships, KPIs, and semantic definitions that can be reused across products and customers.

Balances standard product requirements against ERP-specific and customer-specific requirements and identifies where extensions to the governed model are required.

Works through dependencies across Product, Engineering, Architecture, domain SMEs, Professional Services, customers, and other stakeholders to move semantic-model and Analytics Package work from discovery through validation.

This reflects the actual scope in the resourcing case: reusable semantic models are intended to span Finance, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Inventory, Quality and other domains, with iteration occurring across ERPs and eventually non-Aptean systems.

**Supervision:**

Works with a high degree of independence within defined product priorities and objectives.

Receives strategic direction from the Director, Product Management – Analytics & Data Products and independently drives assigned semantic-model domains and Analytics Package workstreams.

Coordinates work across technical and business stakeholders but does not initially have direct people-management responsibility.

Escalates significant product, data, architecture, and prioritization decisions where broader alignment is required.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Define business semantics and domain models.
* Lead discovery with product SMEs, customers, and internal stakeholders to understand business processes, entities, relationships, terminology, business questions, metrics, and KPIs. Translate these inputs into detailed, reusable semantic-model requirements and domain definitions.
* Analyze source data and define source-to-semantic mappings.
* Work with Product and Data Engineering teams to understand existing products and ERP schemas, including relevant tables, fields, keys, relationships, and business logic. Define and document how source data maps to standardized business entities, dimensions, measures, and relationships within the semantic model, and identify gaps requiring transformation or extension.
* Define Analytics Packages
* Translate business questions, KPIs, reporting requirements, and semantic-model capabilities into reusable Analytics Packages across functional domains such as Finance, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Inventory, and Quality. Define package requirements, measures, dimensions, reporting experiences, acceptance criteria, and dependencies.
* Driving semantic-model requirements through Engineering
* Partner closely with Data Engineering and Architecture to convert product requirements into implementable semantic-model capabilities. Clarify requirements, resolve data and business-rule questions, review model implementations against intended business semantics, identify gaps, and support prioritization through delivery.
* Validate models and packages with customers and SMEs
* Plan and conduct validation sessions with domain SMEs, customers, and implementation teams to confirm that semantic definitions, KPIs, business rules, and Analytics Packages accurately represent real-world processes and reporting needs. Convert validation findings into prioritized product requirements and model improvements.
* Standardize capabilities across products and customers
* Compare requirements and source structures across ERP products and customer environments to distinguish reusable business concepts from product- or customer-specific requirements. Help establish canonical definitions while identifying where governed extensions are necessary…
